sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝175周年，助您理解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特别优惠，访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A few days ago, when President Trump proposed the introduction of a 50-year mortgage, he challenged a bedrock of the American housing market and financial system.
sentences.zh: 几天前，当特朗普总统提议推出50年期房贷时，他挑战了美国住房市场和金融系统的基石。

sentences.en: But above all, he revealed just how desperate he is to lower prices for consumers and how willing he is to embrace radical solutions to do so.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，他暴露了自己是多么渴望为消费者降低价格，以及他为了做到这一点是多么愿意接受激进的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月17日，星期一。

sentences.en: Democrats had a clean sweep around the country on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周二，民主党人在全国范围内取得了压倒性胜利。

sentences.en: It was a resounding demand for relief from the rising cost of living in an off-year election.
sentences.zh: 在这场非大选年选举中，这是对生活成本上升发出的强烈减负诉求。

sentences.en: In the final analysis, the message from the elections two weeks ago in New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，两周前新泽西州选举释放的信息，

sentences.en: Virginia, and New York was exceptionally clear.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州和纽约州的选举信息异常清晰。

sentences.en: The country is unaffordable.
sentences.zh: 这个国家让人生活不起。

sentences.en: People's groceries and bills are still high.
sentences.zh: 人们的食品杂货和账单依然居高不下。

sentences.en: They're still dealing with inflation.
sentences.zh: 他们仍在应对通货膨胀。

sentences.en: They're suffering.
sentences.zh: 他们在苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Focus on domestic policy and on making people's lives better.
sentences.zh: 关注国内政策，改善人们的生活。

sentences.en: Everyone embraced that message, except...
sentences.zh: 每个人都接受了这一信息，除了……

sentences.en: Our energy costs are way down.
sentences.zh: 我们的能源成本大幅下降。

sentences.en: Our groceries are way down.
sentences.zh: 我们的食品杂货价格大幅下降。

sentences.en: Everything is way down.
sentences.zh: 一切都在大幅下降。

sentences.en: For President Trump.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普总统而言。

sentences.en: So, uh, I don't want to hear about the affordability because...
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，我不想听关于负担能力的事，因为……

sentences.en: Who initially dismissed it, much to the consternation of his fellow Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他最初对此不以为然，这令他的共和党同僚们大跌眼镜。

sentences.en: The president says there's virtually no inflation and that grocery prices are going down.
sentences.zh: 总统表示几乎不存在通货膨胀，杂货价格正在下降。

sentences.en: Do you agree with him on that?
sentences.zh: 你同意他的看法吗？

sentences.en: Um, no.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不同意。

sentences.en: I go to the grocery store myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己去杂货店买东西。

sentences.en: Grocery prices remain high.
sentences.zh: 杂货价格依然很高。

sentences.en: Energy prices are high.
sentences.zh: 能源价格很高。

sentences.en: So affordability is a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以负担能力是个问题。

sentences.en: Who said that they agreed with the American people that the president had not done enough to bring down prices.
sentences.zh: 谁曾表示他们认同美国人民的看法，即总统在压低物价方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: So, after a few days of denial, Trump abruptly changed his tune.
sentences.zh: 因此，在否认了几天之后，特朗普突然改变了口风。

sentences.en: Suddenly, he was Mr. Affordability.
sentences.zh: 转瞬间，他成了“负担能力先生”。

sentences.en: President Trump accusing four of the biggest meatpacking companies of driving up U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统指责四家最大的肉类包装公司推高了美国的

sentences.en: beef prices.
sentences.zh: 牛肉价格。

sentences.en: He ordered the Justice Department to investigate whether meatpacking companies have conspired to inflate meat prices.
sentences.zh: 他下令司法部调查肉类包装公司是否串通抬高肉价。

sentences.en: The president now looking into it, you could say he has beef with this particular industry here.
sentences.zh: 总统现在正在着手调查，可以说他和这个特定行业“结下梁子了”。

sentences.en: He lifted his own tariffs on household products like coffee, tomatoes, and bananas
sentences.zh: 他取消了针对咖啡、西红柿和香蕉等家居产品的自身关税，

sentences.en: and floated the idea of giving every American a $2,000 check based on the revenues from his tariffs.
sentences.zh: 并抛出了利用关税收入向每个美国人发放2,000美元支票的想法。

sentences.en: So I want the money to go directly to you, the people.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望这笔钱直接发给你们，也就是人民。

sentences.en: He suggested lowering health care costs by sending consumers a direct federal subsidy.
sentences.zh: 他建议通过向消费者发放直接联邦补贴来降低医疗保健成本。

sentences.en: And you'll go out and you'll buy your own health insurance and you'll negotiate different plans and you'll get much better insurance and you will be an entrepreneur for yourself.
sentences.zh: 然后你会出去购买你自己的医疗保险，你会协商不同的计划，你会获得更好的保险，你将成为自己的创业者。

sentences.en: And finally, he offered a potentially game-changing and extremely controversial idea for reducing the price of housing.
sentences.zh: 最后，他提出了一个可能改变游戏规则且极具争议的想法，用来降低住房价格。

sentences.en: And he announced this idea in a pretty unusual way, even for Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且他以一种相当不同寻常的方式宣布了这个想法，即便是对特朗普而言也是如此。

sentences.en: So Saturday morning, Trump posts this picture on True Social.
sentences.zh: 因此，周六早上，特朗普在“真相社交”上发布了这张照片。

sentences.en: It's just a picture and it says,
sentences.zh: 这只是一张照片，上面写着，

sentences.en: Great American presidents.
sentences.zh: 伟大的美国总统。

sentences.en: Conor Doherty is a housing reporter for The Times.
sentences.zh: 康纳·多尔蒂是《时报》的住房记者。

sentences.en: And on the left, you have Franklin D.
sentences.zh: 左边是富兰克林·D·

sentences.en: Roosevelt.
sentences.zh: 罗斯福。

sentences.en: And above him, it says, 30-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 他上方写着：30年期房贷。

sentences.en: And on the right, you have President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 右边是唐纳德·特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And above him, it says, 50-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 他上方写着：50年期房贷。

sentences.en: And when you saw that, Conor, did you know what that meant?
sentences.zh: 康纳，当你看到这个时，你知道这意味着什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 知道。

sentences.en: Right off the bat, you see, he's trying to come up with an idea that will lower mortgage payments for everyone who has a mortgage.
sentences.zh: 一上手你就能看出来，他正试图想出一个能为所有背负房贷的人降低月供的主意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Address affordability by making housing more affordable.
sentences.zh: 通过让住房更具可负担性来解决负担能力问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Making payments more affordable.
sentences.zh: 让月供更具可负担性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And quite importantly, this image puts him in the pantheon of great presidents who radically rearrange the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且相当重要的一点是，这张图片把他置于那些根本性重塑美国

sentences.en: housing market.
sentences.zh: 住房市场的伟大总统的殿堂之中。

sentences.en: And to use that image maybe as a roadmap here, let's talk about the left side image, FDR and the 30-year mortgage,
sentences.zh: 为了把这张图当作这里的路线图，我们来谈谈左边的图片，罗斯福与30年期房贷，

sentences.en: which is the starting point for Trump and I suspect for this conversation.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普的起点，我猜也是这次谈话的起点。

sentences.en: So I suppose what we should probably do is go to a little bit before FDR
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们大概应该回溯到罗斯福之前的一段时间，

sentences.en: and say what the housing market used to be like.
sentences.zh: 说说过去的住房市场是什么样的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Many fewer Americans owned their homes and they had a lot of different ways for borrowing the money to buy a home.
sentences.zh: 拥有自己住房的美国人要少得多，他们有很多不同的借钱买房的方式。

sentences.en: Now, one of the most popular models was something called building and loan associations.
sentences.zh: 当时最流行的模式之一叫做“建筑与贷款协会”。

sentences.en: Some of your older or film buff listeners might know that during the movie It's a Wonderful Life, there's a fictional company called the Bailey Brothers Building and Loan.
sentences.zh: 你们当中年龄较大或者喜欢电影的听众可能会知道，在电影《生活多美好》中，有一家虚构的公司叫贝利兄弟建筑与贷款公司。

sentences.en: So basically, they're co-ops.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，它们是合作社。

sentences.en: A bunch of people buy into what is essentially a pool of money and then they can borrow from that pool of money their shareholders in this pool
sentences.zh: 一群人出资注入一个本质上是资金池的东西，然后他们可以从这个资金池里借钱，他们是这个池子里的股东，

sentences.en: and then that allows them to borrow money from it.
sentences.zh: 然后这使他们能够从中借钱。

sentences.en: It's a very complicated model.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的模式。

sentences.en: It had a lot of risk to it.
sentences.zh: 它有很多风险。

sentences.en: But the point is that it's a very haphazard market.
sentences.zh: 但重点是这是一个非常杂乱无章的市场。

sentences.en: And it's a market that the government has essentially no involvement in.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个政府基本不予介入的市场。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So during the Great Depression, obviously, there's total chaos.
sentences.zh: 所以在经济大萧条时期，显而易见，是一片彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: There's a huge run on banks.
sentences.zh: 出现了大规模的银行挤兑。

sentences.en: Credit is just completely pulled back in various ways.
sentences.zh: 信贷以各种方式彻底收缩。

sentences.en: And it makes it really, really hard to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 这使得买房变得极其、极其艰难。

sentences.en: FDR is seen as the person who brought the government into the housing market in a big way.
sentences.zh: 罗斯福被视为将政府大规模引入住房市场的人。

sentences.en: After the Great Depression, government does a bunch of different things.
sentences.zh: 大萧条之后，政府做了很多不同的事情。

sentences.en: One is they really try to make standard this idea of what's called an amortizable mortgage,
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是他们极力推行所谓的“可分期偿还房贷”的概念，

sentences.en: which means you have one payment and you do your principal and interest in one easy payment.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你只需要付一笔款，通过一笔简单的付款就能付清本金和利息。

sentences.en: The other thing is they start encouraging longer-term mortgages.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是他们开始鼓励长期房贷。

sentences.en: Now, longer-term mortgages are going to be more affordable because the monthly payment is going to be much less if you can extend it over, say, 30 years instead of 10 years.
sentences.zh: 如今，长期房贷将更具可负担性，因为如果你能将期限延长到比如30年而不是10年，每月的还款额就会少得多。

sentences.en: The problem is banks don't really want to do long mortgages.
sentences.zh: 问题是银行其实不想做长期贷款。

sentences.en: They don't like it because if interest rates go up, they have to pay more money to the people who put money in their bank,
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢这样，因为如果利率上升，他们必须向把钱存入银行的人支付更多的钱，

sentences.en: but they're still getting the same amount of money from the people who've borrowed money for the home.
sentences.zh: 但他们从贷款买房的人那里收到的钱还是那么多。

sentences.en: So the government says, okay, well, we'll help you with that problem by covering you if these loans start to go belly up.
sentences.zh: 所以政府说，好吧，如果这些贷款开始破产，我们会为你兜底，以此来帮你解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Now, exactly how they do this is this very, very complicated mortgage system that we now have.
sentences.zh: 至于他们具体是如何做到这一点的，就是我们现在拥有的这个非常、非常复杂的房贷系统。

sentences.en: But the whole point of all of this is to make it easier for more people to buy homes and for that home to be sort of wrapped around one easy payment.
sentences.zh: 但这一切的核心目的，就是让更多人买房变得更容易，并把房贷整合成一笔简单的付款。

sentences.en: So out of the economic calamity that was the Great Depression comes this effort by the government to encourage as many Americans as possible to buy a home
sentences.zh: 因此，在大萧条这场经济灾难之后，政府努力通过确保尽可能多的美国人能够通过一个很长的周期来买房，从而让买房变得更加经济实惠，这就是我们现在所知的固定利率30年期房贷。

sentences.en: by ensuring that they can do so over a very long period that makes it more affordable with what we now think of as the fixed-rate 30-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，从某种意义上说，我们要感谢大萧条带来了这个。

sentences.en: Interestingly, we can thank the Great Depression, in a sense, for that.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 那个系统正是我们拥有极高住房自有率的原因。

sentences.en: That system is why we have a huge home ownership rate.
sentences.zh: 大约三分之二的美国人拥有自己的住房。

sentences.en: About two-thirds of Americans own their home.
sentences.zh: 如果没有30年期固定利率房贷，这个数字会低得多。

sentences.en: That number would be way lower without their 30-year fixed mortgage.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一笔划算得惊人的交易，因为利率是固定的。

sentences.en: And it's just an incredible deal because the interest rate is fixed.
sentences.zh: 你的每月贷款还款额是冻结的，即使通货膨胀抬头也是如此。

sentences.en: Your monthly loan payment is frozen, even if inflation picks up.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，如果利率大幅下降，你可以进行再融资。

sentences.en: On top of that, if rates go way down, you can refinance.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以随着时间的推移，你实际上可以降低你的利率，我不久前刚这么做过。

sentences.en: So you can actually lower your rate over time, which I did not too long ago.
sentences.zh: 因此，你获得了固定利率的所有好处，而没有它的任何缺点。

sentences.en: So you get all the benefits of a fixed rate with none of the downsides.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们拥有非常高的住房自有率。

sentences.en: And that is why we have a really high home ownership rate.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们花一会儿时间来谈谈。

sentences.en: Now, let's talk for a second.
sentences.zh: 为什么政府要让人更容易借钱？

sentences.en: Why would the government want to make it easier for people to borrow money?
sentences.zh: 嗯，原因在于，如果你借钱是为了购买一项资产——一套房子、一样能够保值甚至有望升值的东西，

sentences.en: Well, the reason is, if you're borrowing money to buy an asset, a home, something that's going to hold its value, hopefully increase in value,
sentences.zh: 这和刷信用卡账单去吃一顿外卖是有所不同的。

sentences.en: it's kind of different than running up a credit card bill to get takeout one night.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府构建了所有这些金融管道，因为它希望人们购买稳定的资产。

sentences.en: So the government has all this financial plumbing created because it wants people to buy a stable asset.
sentences.zh: 这对于他们的家庭来说是稳定的。

sentences.en: It's stable for their family.
sentences.zh: 它具有强制储蓄功能。

sentences.en: It has forced savings.
sentences.zh: 即使房子没有升值或者升值表现不佳，你依然在攒下所有的钱，而如果你只是租房，你是做不到这一点的。

sentences.en: Even if the home doesn't appreciate or appreciates not very well, you're still saving all that money, which you would not be doing if you were just renting.
sentences.zh: 所以你借了所有这些钱来建立某种稳定性。

sentences.en: So you're borrowing all this money to kind of create stability.
sentences.zh: 你创造了扎根于社区的人群。

sentences.en: You create people who are rooted in neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 你创造了一种人们可以拥有并传给孩子的资产。

sentences.en: You create an asset that people can own and pass to their children.
sentences.zh: 你创造了一种退休储蓄形式。

sentences.en: You create a form of retirement savings.
sentences.zh: 那么，既然你所说的30年期固定利率房贷管用而且相当管用，我们为什么还要去动它呢？

sentences.en: So why would we ever mess with a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage if, from what you're saying, it kind of works and works pretty well?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 房子变得贵得多了。

sentences.en: Homes have become much more expensive.
sentences.zh: 它们变得更贵有许多复杂的原因，但人们看到的是那笔房贷月供。

sentences.en: There are a lot of complicated reasons for why they become more expensive, but the way that people see it is that mortgage payment.
sentences.zh: 房地产行业有一句格言说，你其实不是在买房子，而是在买一份月供。

sentences.en: There's an adage in the real estate industry that says, you don't actually buy a house, you buy a payment.
sentences.zh: 人们把这份月供当作他们能否实现置业梦想的晴雨表。

sentences.en: People use that payment as their barometer for, can they or can they not achieve the dream of becoming a homeowner?
sentences.zh: 因此，由于各种各样的原因，在过去几年里，这笔月供变得昂贵了许多。

sentences.en: So this payment has gotten a lot more expensive over the past couple of years for a whole bunch of different reasons.
sentences.zh: 一个是房子本身就更贵了。

sentences.en: One is homes just cost more.
sentences.zh: 所以如果房子更贵，月供就会更高。

sentences.en: So if homes cost more, it's going to be a higher payment.
sentences.zh: 另一个是利率上升了。

sentences.en: The other is interest rates have gone up.
sentences.zh: 比疫情期间的谷底水平高出不少。

sentences.en: Quite a bit from their rock bottom level in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这让人们感觉非常糟糕，因为他们所有的朋友都拿到了2%的利率，而他们现在却被6%的利率套牢了。

sentences.en: And that is making people feel really bad because all their friends got 2% interest rates and now they're stuck with 6%.
sentences.zh: 所以房子更贵了，钱也更贵了。

sentences.en: So homes are more expensive and money is more expensive.
sentences.zh: 因此，月供比过去高出了不少。

sentences.en: And so that payment has gone up quite a bit from what it was.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 30年期固定利率房贷让人感觉已经很不具可负担性了。

So if you are buying a $500,000 home, for instance, you're paying that purchase price over 50 years instead of 30 years.

sentences.zh: 所以，假设你按目前的房贷利率购买了一套50万美元的房子，首付20%，对于30年期来说，你的月供大约是从2500美元（对吧）降到大约

sentences.en: Yeah, you'd be pretty pleased.

sentences.zh: 所以从理论上讲，如果50年期房贷真的存在了，

sentences.en: market if it came into existence and if it lowered home monthly payments by the amount we're talking about?
sentences.zh: 并且把人们的月供降到了我们谈论的这个幅度，它会对美国市场产生什么影响？

sentences.en: It's hard to say exactly how it would impact the market, but it would turn up the heat.

sentences.en: That, in turn, could get home builders to increase the pace of new construction because the lines are growing again.

sentences.en: So it would definitely stimulate the housing market in a great many ways because more people can buy homes now.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you can see why this would be an attractive option for the president of the United States
sentences.zh: 所以你可以理解为什么这对美国总统来说会是一个有吸引力的选择，

sentences.en: at a moment when everyone's telling him there's a real affordability problem in this country and it's typified by the unaffordability of the housing markets.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个时刻：所有人都在告诉他这个国家存在严重的买房难问题，而这正是房地产市场难以承受的高昂价格的写照。

sentences.en: You can see why it would be tempting to post that image and just make a 30-year mortgage suddenly a 50-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 你可以理解为什么发布那张图片、把30年期房贷突然变成50年期会让人觉得那么诱人。

sentences.en: Oh, totally.
sentences.zh: 哦，完全是。

sentences.en: I mean, if you're a president who wants to do anything for affordability, coming up with a thing that will change someone's monthly bill is really appealing because it would
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你是一个想要为提高可负担性做点什么的总统，提出一个能改变人们每月账单的方案真的很有吸引力，因为它会

sentences.en: lower payments and it would lower them in an obvious way that people could see in their budget.
sentences.zh: 降低还款额，而且是以一种人们能在预算中清晰看到的方式显着降低。

sentences.en: And so what is the response to this idea once Trump posts it?
sentences.zh: 那么，在特朗普发布这个想法后，外界作何反应？

sentences.en: That image of himself and FDR and the concept of a 50-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 也就是他自己和罗斯福的合影以及50年期房贷的概念。

sentences.en: People just annihilate this idea.
sentences.zh: 人们把这个想法喷得体无完肤。

sentences.en: So, Connor, why is everyone panning this idea?
sentences.zh: 那么，康纳，为什么每个人都在痛批这个想法？

sentences.en: What is so wrong with the 50-year mortgage?
sentences.zh: 50年期房贷到底有什么问题？

sentences.en: Okay, so the problem is, it looks like it saves you money.
sentences.zh: 好的，问题在于，它看起来像是能为你省钱。

sentences.en: Let's return to our example.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到我们的例子。

sentences.en: You have the $500,000 house with the current 6.2% mortgage rate.
sentences.zh: 你有一套价值50万美元的房子，当前的房贷利率是6.2%。

sentences.en: You go from $2,500 to $2,200.
sentences.zh: 你的月供从2500美元降到了2200美元。

sentences.en: You've saved yourself 300 bucks.
sentences.zh: 你省下了300大洋。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, in the first example, 30 years, you're going to end up paying about $500,000 in intereSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，在第一个例子中，也就是30年期，你最终将支付大约50万美元的利息。

sentences.en: You pay basically the house in intereSt.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是在利息上花了一套房子的钱。

sentences.en: By $500,000 house, you pay about $500,000 in intereSt.
sentences.zh: 买一套50万美元的房子，你大约要支付50万美元的利息。

sentences.en: A lot of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 大量的利息。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay, now let's go to the second example.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我们来看第二个例子。

sentences.en: You take that house and you buy it over 50 years.
sentences.zh: 你买下那套房子，并在50年内还清贷款。

sentences.en: Well, now you're going to end up spending about $900,000 in intereSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在你最终将花费大约90万美元的利息。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A significant amount more.
sentences.zh: 多出了惊人的一大截。

sentences.en: So, almost a million dollars in interest for your $500,000 house.
sentences.zh: 所以，为了你这套50万美元的房子，你要支付将近100万美元的利息。

sentences.en: Wow, you're paying way more in interest than you are for your house.
sentences.zh: 哇，你在利息上花的钱比买房本身的钱还要多得多。

sentences.en: You're basically buying your house twice, but you're paying the bank for a whole other version of your house.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是把房子买了两遍，而且你还在为银行提供你的房子的另一个完整版本的钱。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, and the reason is it's 20 more years of paying intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，原因在于你要多付20年的利息。

sentences.en: So, a major, major downside of a 50-year mortgage is 20 extra years of forking over interest payments to the bank.
sentences.zh: 因此，50年期房贷一个重大、重大的缺点就是，要向银行额外上交20年的利息付款。

sentences.en: And not only that, there's some questions about whether or not it would even really save you money.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，关于它是否真的能为你省钱，还存在一些疑问。

sentences.en: So, for instance, if banks are going to be doing 50-year mortgages, the interest rate on the 50-year mortgage is almost certainly going to be higher than on a 30-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，如果银行要推出50年期房贷，那么50年期房贷的利率几乎肯定会比30年期房贷的利率更高。

sentences.en: And the reason is a 50-year mortgage is much riskier.
sentences.zh: 原因在于50年期房贷的风险要大得多。

sentences.en: If you're lending someone money over 50 years instead of 30 years, there's a much higher chance that something will go wrong in those 50 years.
sentences.zh: 如果你把钱借给别人50年而不是30年，在这50年里出问题的几率要高得多。

sentences.en: On top of that, if you are buying that home after 50 years, it takes you a lot longer to start owning real equity in that home.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，如果你是在50年后才买下这套房，你要花长得多的时间才能开始真正拥有这套房子的净资产。

sentences.en: As anybody knows, looking at their mortgage statement, in the first few years, you're mainly only paying intereSt.
sentences.zh: 正如任何看过自己房贷对账单的人所知，在前几年，你主要支付的都只是利息。

sentences.en: And in the last years, you're mainly only paying principal.
sentences.zh: 而在最后几年，你主要支付的才只是本金。

sentences.en: So, it would take you 20 years to start really having significant equity in the house.
sentences.zh: 所以，你要花20年的时间才能真正开始拥有这套房子的大笔净资产。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I guess we should probably mention the reality that if a lot of Americans started to take out 50-year mortgages,
sentences.zh: 我想我们或许应该提一下这样一个现实：如果大量美国人开始申请50年期房贷，

sentences.en: and we assume many people don't start taking them out until they're in their late 30s and early 40s, which is when a lot of Americans now embark on home ownership,
sentences.zh: 而且我们假设许多人直到30岁快结束或40岁出头时才开始申请（这也是现在很多美国人开始拥有一套属于自己的房子的年龄），

sentences.en: a lot of people are not going to make it to the end of these mortgages.
sentences.zh: 很多人根本活不到这些房贷还清的那一天。

sentences.en: I mean, they're going to die, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们会死掉，对吧？

sentences.en: Unquestionably.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Now, what's really striking about the critiques of this idea is just how much of it is coming from within Trump's party and some of Trump's closest allies.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于对这个想法的批判，最令人瞩目的是，其中很大一部分声音竟然来自特朗普的党内以及特朗普的一些最亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: You have Laura Loomer, the conservative activist, saying lifetime mortgages.
sentences.zh: 保守派活动人士劳拉·鲁默说这是“终身房贷”。

sentences.en: You have Marjorie Taylor Greene, who is one of the most strongly associated with America FirSt.
sentences.zh: 玛乔丽·泰勒·格林是与“美国优先”联系最紧密的人之一。

sentences.en: Well, she says you'll be in debt for life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她说你会负债终生。

sentences.en: If you have Christopher Ruffo, another conservative activist, saying if you have a 15- or 30-year mortgage, you'll actually own your home, whereas a 50-year mortgage,
sentences.zh: 还有克里斯托弗·鲁福，另一位保守派活动人士，他说如果你有15年期或30年期的房贷，你实际上会拥有你的房子，而如果是50年期的房贷，

sentences.en: you're never going to own your home.
sentences.zh: 你永远也别想拥有你的房子。

sentences.en: Essentially, you're just renting it from the bank now.
sentences.zh: 本质上，你现在只是从银行手里租房。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Many people from all across the political spectrum sort of recognize this as a very risky deal.
sentences.zh: 来自政治光谱各个角落的许多人都某种程度上认识到这是一笔风险极高的交易。

sentences.en: So is it fair to say that this is probably not about to become the new gold standard of American mortgages?
sentences.zh: 所以说这大概不会成为美国房贷的新黄金标准，这话公道吗？

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say they're going back to the drawing board on this one.
sentences.zh: 我认为说他们正在为此重新回到图纸前设计，是很公道的。

sentences.en: So if this idea isn't really going anywhere at the moment, what else is coming out of this administration that would potentially confront the unaffordability of housing right now?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这个想法目前无疾而终，那么政府还会推出什么其他政策来潜在地应对眼下买房难的问题呢？

sentences.en: So Bill Pulte, the Trump administration official, said this was just one of several ideas.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普政府官员比尔·普尔特表示，这只是几种构想中的一种。

sentences.en: Another would be portable mortgages where you could take your mortgage rate with you to another house.
sentences.zh: 另一个是可转移房贷，你可以把你的房贷利率带到另一所房子里去。

sentences.en: That would hopefully open up inventory because a lot of Americans right now have lower mortgage rates and want to move but aren't going to because they don't want to have to buy a new house at a higher mortgage rate.
sentences.zh: 这有望释放库存，因为目前许多美国人享有较低的房贷利率，他们想要搬家，但不会搬，因为他们不想以更高的房贷利率去买新房。

sentences.en: So that might encourage more people to move.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会鼓励更多人搬家。

sentences.en: So it would unstick the housing market potentially.
sentences.zh: 因此它可能会盘活房地产市场。

sentences.en: Another one would be assumable mortgages.
sentences.zh: 还有一个是可承接房贷。

sentences.en: So that's kind of the same idea from a different direction.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是从不同方向出发的同一个想法。

sentences.en: If you buy a home and the person who owns the home has a killer low interest rate, you might be able to assume their mortgage and their mortgage rate when you buy the house.
sentences.zh: 如果你买了一套房子，而房主拥有一个极低的惊人利率，那么当你买房时，你也许可以接手他们的房贷和房贷利率。

sentences.en: So that would encourage someone to move.
sentences.zh: 所以这会鼓励某人搬家。

sentences.en: That would encourage someone to buy, etc.
sentences.zh: 这会鼓励某人买房，等等。

sentences.en: Are any of these practical?
sentences.zh: 这些切合实际吗？

sentences.en: Are they achievable?
sentences.zh: 它们能够实现吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 大概不能。

sentences.en: What you're seeing, though, is all the same type of idea, which is how do we fiddle with the debt?
sentences.zh: 不过，你所看到的是所有这些都属于同一类型的思路，那就是我们如何摆弄债务？

sentences.en: How do we fiddle with mortgage rates in such a way that we can attack the payment,
sentences.zh: 我们如何以某种方式摆弄房贷利率来应对月供，

sentences.en: either by extending it with the fifth year or essentially winding back in time to give people access to mortgage rates that reflect mortgage rates of 10 years ago?
sentences.zh: 要么通过拉长到50年来延长它，要么本质上时光倒流，让人们能够获得反映10年前水平的房贷利率？

sentences.en: But there's one big thing we're missing here, which is that the reason housing is so expensive is that we have a really bad housing shortage in the country.
sentences.zh: 但这里我们漏掉了一个重大问题，那就是房屋之所以如此昂贵，是因为我们国家的住房短缺非常严重。

sentences.en: We stopped building housing is essentially stopped building housing after the Great Recession and have never caught up.
sentences.zh: 我们在大萧条之后基本上就停止建造房屋了，而且再也没有赶上进度。

sentences.en: So if you want to have any real impact on affordability, you have to eventually attack that problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想对可负担性产生任何真正的实质影响，你最终必须着手解决那个问题。

sentences.en: And attacking the mortgage rate stuff, all it really does is make it easier for more people to buy what is basically the same number of homes.
sentences.zh: 而处理房贷利率的那些把戏，实际上所做的一切只是让更多人更容易地买下基本上数量相同的房屋。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It attacks a symptom by definition.
sentences.zh: 按定义来说，这只是在对付症状。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And the problem with the housing shortage is that it takes a long time to have any impact on.
sentences.zh: 而住房短缺的问题在于，需要很长时间才能产生任何影响。

sentences.en: And it's not a thing that the president has a lot of control over.
sentences.zh: 而且这不是总统能够拥有很大控制权的事情。

sentences.en: There are state regulations for how you build housing.
sentences.zh: 关于如何建造房屋，有各州的规章制度。

sentences.en: There are local regulations for how you build housing.
sentences.zh: 关于如何建造房屋，有地方的规章制度。

sentences.en: All this stuff that just breaks your brain, the White House doesn't have much control or even influence over.
sentences.zh: 所有这些让人头疼的东西，白宫并没有太多的控制权甚至影响力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's the province of governors.
sentences.zh: 那是各州州长的管辖范围。

sentences.en: It's the province of mayors.
sentences.zh: 那是各市市长的管辖范围。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So around the country, you are seeing states really go after this supply problem.
sentences.zh: 所以在全国各地，你可以看到各州确实在着手解决这个供应问题。

sentences.en: You've seen Florida, Montana, Texas, California, Oregon, Arizona, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 你已经看到佛罗里达州、蒙大拿州、德克萨斯州、加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州、亚利桑那州、马萨诸塞州。

sentences.en: All of these states have had some kind of effort to essentially lower their housing regulations to make it easier to build housing in hopes that they will inspire home builders to go through a building boom.
sentences.zh: 所有这些州都做出过某种努力，本质上是放宽其住房法规，以便更轻松地建造房屋，期望以此激发房屋建筑商迎来建设热潮。

sentences.en: But these solutions all take a really long time.
sentences.zh: 但这些解决方案都需要很长时间。

sentences.en: And they can also be controversial.
sentences.zh: 而且它们也可能引起争议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In California, for instance, they just passed a law that changes zoning.
sentences.zh: 例如在加利福尼亚州，他们刚刚通过了一项改变土地区划的法律。

sentences.en: It makes it much easier to build higher density housing in existing neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 它使得在现有社区中建造高密度住房变得容易多了。

sentences.en: Well, the legislature who passed that bill has been working on a version of this for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，通过那项法案的立法机构为此类版本已经努力了10年。

sentences.en: And it only passed after people fought like crazy against it because they don't want taller buildings in their single family neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 而且它是在人们疯狂反对之后才得以通过的，因为他们不想在自己的单一家庭住宅区看到更高的建筑。

sentences.en: Even if all these things happen after going through all that difficult politics, it'll still be years before developers get projects approved, before they start building them,
sentences.zh: 即便经历所有这些艰难的政治博弈后这些事情真的发生了，开发商要获批项目、开始建设，

sentences.en: before there's enough units to impact the supply that people would really notice in prices.
sentences.zh: 还要等到有足够多的住房单元来对人们真切感受得到的房价产生实质影响，依然需要数年时间。

sentences.en: So this work is just grinding hard work that's also kind of thankless.
sentences.zh: 所以这项工作只是一项艰难繁重、而且有点吃力不讨好的苦差事。

sentences.en: And it feels like the states have kind of run out of options.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉各州似乎已经用尽了各种选择。

sentences.en: And so they are doing the hard work.
sentences.zh: 因此他们正在埋头苦干。

sentences.en: So let's say all these states, California, whatever, Texas, actually have a huge impact on the supply and actually they lower prices for people.
sentences.zh: 假设所有这些州，比如加州、不管哪个州，还有德州，真的对供应量产生了巨大影响，真的把房价降了下来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Let's say it's a resounding success.
sentences.zh: 假设这是一次巨大的成功。

sentences.en: That resounding success is unlikely to happen in anyone's political lifetime.
sentences.zh: 这种巨大的成功在任何人的政治生涯中都不太可能发生。

sentences.en: It's certainly not going to happen before the 2026 midterMs.
sentences.zh: 它肯定不会在2026年中期选举之前发生。

sentences.en: And it's very unlikely to have a huge, huge noticeable impact on prices by 2028.
sentences.zh: 而且到2028年，它对房价产生巨大、显著影响的可能性也非常小。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: From everything you're saying, the real solutions to the American housing crisis of unaffordability right now isn't flashy.
sentences.zh: 从你所说的一切来看，目前解决美国住房负担能力危机的真正办法一点也不显眼。

sentences.en: It isn't quick.
sentences.zh: 它不是立竿见影的。

sentences.en: It's not a true social post with two presidents on it.
sentences.zh: 它不是那种带有两位总统头像的真实社交媒体帖子。

sentences.en: It's not a 50-year mortgage.
sentences.zh: 它也不是50年期抵押贷款。

sentences.en: It's this very unsexy, difficult, slow, brain-breaking work of changing the way zoning works and stimulating local housing markets.
sentences.zh: 它是那种非常枯燥、艰难、缓慢、让人绞尽脑汁的工作，比如改变土地区划规则以及刺激地方住房市场。

sentences.en: And it's probably not going to be coming from the White House.
sentences.zh: 而且它大概率不会来自白宫。

sentences.en: Absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I think the federal government can be a huge part of this story.
sentences.zh: 我认为联邦政府可以在这个故事中发挥巨大作用。

sentences.en: I think there are lots of things the federal government can do to help these efforts that are happening in state and local governments.
sentences.zh: 我认为联邦政府可以做很多事情来协助州和地方政府正在进行的这些努力。

sentences.en: But they're not going to be the author of them.
sentences.zh: 但他们不会是这些努力的主导者。

sentences.en: Well, Conor, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，康纳，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: One of the Republican Party's most high-profile alliances between President Trump and Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene of Georgia officially imploded over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 共和党内最受关注的联盟之一——特朗普总统与佐治亚州众议员马乔里·泰勒·格林之间的关系，在周末正式破裂。

sentences.en: Greene, a once fierce Trump advocate who backed his efforts to overturn the 2020 election results,
sentences.zh: 格林曾是特朗普的坚定拥护者，曾支持他推翻2020年大选结果的努力，

sentences.en: has infuriated Trump recently by criticizing his handling of the economy and the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.
sentences.zh: 但最近却因批评他处理经济和杰弗里·爱泼斯坦调查的方式而激怒了特朗普。

sentences.en: As a result, Trump withdrew his support for Greene, called her a traitor, and accused her of becoming a Republican in name only.
sentences.zh: 结果，特朗普撤回了对格林的支持，称她为叛徒，并指责她成了名义上的共和党人。

sentences.en: What do you think happened?
sentences.zh: 你觉得发生了什么？

sentences.en: What do you think is the reason for this?
sentences.zh: 你认为这背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it has all come down to the Epstein files, and that is shocking.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这一切都归结于爱泼斯坦的文件，这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I stand with these women.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我支持这些女性。

sentences.en: I stand with rape victims, and I will not apologize for that.
sentences.zh: 我支持强奸受害者，我对此绝不道歉。

sentences.en: In an interview on Sunday with CNN, Greene said that she still supports Trump, but expressed alarm at the ferocity of his attacks on her over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 格林在周日接受CNN采访时表示，她仍然支持特朗普，但对他过去几天攻击她的猛烈程度感到震惊。

sentences.en: The most hurtful thing he said, which is absolutely untrue, is he called me a traitor.
sentences.zh: 他说过的最伤人、而且完全不属实的话，就是叫我叛徒。

sentences.en: And that is so extremely wrong, and those are the types of words used that can radicalize people against me and put my life in danger.
sentences.zh: 这太离谱了，这些言论可能会煽动人们针对我，并将我的生命置于危险之中。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, President Trump ended his effort to stop House Republicans, including Representative Greene,
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，特朗普总统停止了阻止众议院共和党人（包括格林众议员）的行动，

sentences.en: from backing a bill that would force the administration to release all of its files on Epstein.
sentences.zh: 不再阻止他们支持一项迫使政府公布爱泼斯坦所有档案的法案。

sentences.en: Trump had previously fought the measure.
sentences.zh: 特朗普此前曾极力反对这项动议。

sentences.en: The bill is expected to pass later this week, and so by endorsing it now,
sentences.zh: 该法案预计将在本周晚些时候获得通过，因此通过现在予以背书，

sentences.en: Trump hopes to avoid a potentially major embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 特朗普希望避免一场潜在的重大尴尬。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Mary Wilson, Ricky Nevetsky, and Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由妮娜·费尔德曼、玛丽·威尔逊、里基·内韦茨基和杰西卡·钟制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威兰斯和迈克尔·贝努瓦剪辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Dan Powell, Marion Lozano, and Diane Wong, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔、马里昂·洛萨诺和黛安·王创作的音乐，并由艾莉莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《今日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《切割机秀》。

sentences.en: Let's take care.
sentences.zh: 多保重。
